commands.name: menu
commands.help: recent items and new from inbox (default)

commands.name: new
commands.help: wizard for an inbox PDF

args.help: worker processes of the analysis and the build: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto)

commands.name: list
commands.help: all library items, or those matching words

commands.name: show
commands.help: one item: status, parts, settings and what is not built yet

commands.name: plan
commands.help: choose paper, staff size and fold-outs of a part by its page turns (read-only until you pick an option; partitor plan --help)

args.help: a part or group, then the option number to set; default: groups and parts with a bad turn
try a group the item does not have, e.g. AltTen=Alto,Tenor (part names or numbers): built in a temporary copy and shown; repeat for more groups
show every option (default: the option as built and the best of each paper)

commands.name: rebuild
commands.help: build; with parts or groups: only those (the other part files stay)

args.help: numbers (3, 2-4), names (Trombones, Bass Trombone) or all; default: every part
worker processes: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto)

commands.name: pages
commands.help: the pages of a built part and the turn after each; --move PAGE=N moves a system to the next page

args.help: one part or group, name or number
move the last N systems of PAGE to the next page (N negative: bring the first systems of the next page up); the part is paged again
drop the manual page breaks and the pins of the part
show the pages after --move, save nothing

commands.name: repage
commands.help: new page breaks from the saved systems: turns while resting, manual breaks (no analysis, no build)

args.help: numbers, names or all; default: every built part

commands.name: proof
commands.help: draw proof.pdf again (names, ambitus, bar numbers, letters)

commands.name: expand
commands.help: one step larger: one more page, then more space between staves; saved, not built (--build: build too)

args.help: one part or group only (default: all)

commands.name: contract
commands.help: one step smaller: one page less, then less space between staves; saved, not built (--build: build too)

args.help: one part or group only (default: all)

commands.name: bars
commands.help: bar numbers and rehearsal marks (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too)

commands.name: parts
commands.help: part names, parts not extracted, parts joined (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too)

commands.name: groups
commands.help: group scores: several parts printed together (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too)

commands.name: meta
commands.help: title, subtitle and composer (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too)

commands.name: cues
commands.help: cues of one part: small staves of another voice above a rest (menu; saved, not built)

args.help: one part or group (default: choose in the menu)

commands.name: cue
commands.help: the same cues for several parts: cue ID 3=97-98 --parts Tenore,5 (saved, not built)

args.help: 3=97-98 (voice and bars; options after, in one quoted line: "3=97-98 fit sync=3") or "Canto"=97 (a word)
parts or groups: names or numbers, comma separated

commands.name: reid
commands.help: old YYYY-NNN item: new id YYYY-MM-NNNN (renames files)

commands.name: rename
commands.help: folder name follows the title and composer

commands.name: analyse
commands.help: analyse the source again (proof, allocation)

args.help: ask nothing; open choices stay for rebuild
no system ends after staff N of source page P: two systems the analysis took apart are one (p5:4); saved, kept by every analysis; then analyse
leave a whole system out (a title, a piece of another work above the music): p1.s1; no part reads it, it counts no bars, every analysis keeps it; not analysed, not built
put a dropped system back (choices ask for its parts)

commands.name: set
commands.help: change settings; saved, not built (--build: build too)

args.help: title=..., gap=11, pages=3, ...; one part: "Continuo:pages=4"; none: list every key with its value and default

commands.name: log
commands.help: print a run log (needs PARTITOR_LOG_DIR; docs/OPERATING.md)

args.help: 1 = the newest log (default), 2 = the one before, or a file name

commands.name: pieces
commands.help: list the pieces of a PDF: runs of music pages (no library, no files written)

commands.name: detect
commands.help: analyse a PDF without the library: writes layout.yaml and the preview (then edit it, then build)

args.help: pages to analyse: N or A-B (default: all)
part names, comma separated, top staff first (default: read from the printed labels)
text above a page's first staff farther than this, in staff spaces, is dropped (page title, running header)
output folder (default: <pdf name>.partitor next to the PDF)
worker processes for the page analysis: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto)

commands.name: build
commands.help: build the parts of a PDF from its layout.yaml (no library); options override the layout

args.help: pages to build: N or A-B (as in detect)
folder of layout.yaml and the parts (default: <pdf name>.partitor next to the PDF)
largest size, 1 = source size (default: up to --max-staff-mm)
staff spaces between staves, the widest (10)
smallest space between staves, to save a page turn (7)
least space between the ink of two systems, in staff spaces (1)
bar number at each system start, or none (start)
least height of a bar number above the staff, staff spaces (1)
mm added at the spine in double-sided print (5)
also a large-print copy per part (on)
cut new systems at barlines for a larger staff (off; on hold)
title page for 3+ pages of music printed double-sided (auto)
compress = empty staves and rest-only bars become multi-bar rests (compress)
H-bar of a multi-bar rest: engraved = thin serifs (as in Bravura), bold = thicker, heavy = the look of 0.8.30 (engraved)
worker processes: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto)
build these parts or groups only
